Features.section_title: Your AI Business Assistant That Never Sleeps
Features.section_description: Handle more customers, reduce no-shows, and grow your business with intelligent automation designed for service professionals.
Features.feature1_description: AI receptionist answers every call professionally, schedules appointments, and captures customer information 24/7.
Features.feature2_description: Customers can book instantly via phone or online. AI checks availability, prevents double-booking, and sends confirmations.
Features.feature3_description: Reduce no-shows by 70% with automated reminders, confirmments, and post-appointment follow-ups.
Features.feature4_description: Automatically track customer preferences, appointment history, and contact details for personalized service.
Features.feature5_description: Sync with Google Calendar, Outlook, or your existing booking system. Real-time availability updates.
Features.feature6_description: Track booking trends, peak hours, customer satisfaction, and revenue metrics to optimize your business.
